messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Pregnancy:
Follow your doctor's instructions about using metformin if you are pregnant or you become pregnant.
Controlling diabetes is very important during pregnancy.
Having high blood sugar may cause complications in both the mother and the baby.
Tell your doctor if you become pregnant while taking metformin.
Metformin may stimulate ovulation in some women.
Metformin may increase the risk of unintended pregnancy.
Talk to your doctor about your risk.
Breastfeeding:
Talk to your healthcare provider if you are breastfeeding or plan to breastfeed.
Metformin can pass into your breast milk.
Your healthcare provider will be able to advise you about the best way to feed your baby while you take Metformin.
Triplet: ["Metformin", "may increase risk of", "unintended pregnancy"]

The relation 'may increase risk of' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug or factor may elevate the likelihood of the specified adverse event or condition.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'increases risk of': Taking the subject drug may raise the patient's likelihood of experiencing the condition or event specified by the object entity.
B. 'has side effect more likely in': The subject drug is more likely to cause the specified adverse effect or reaction in the population or group specified by the object entity.
C. 'improves': The subject drug enhances or positively affects the condition or parameter specified by the object entity.
D. 'has dose adjustment instruction': The subject drug may require changes in dosage based on the condition or factor specified in the object entity.
E. 'may affect': The subject drug may influence or alter the physiological process or condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
